title: Voopoo PnP-X Replacement Pods
description: The Voopoo PnP X integrated-coil pods simplify pod upkeep with a built-in PnP X coil and a clean 2ml refill design. Each pack includes two pods in your chosen resistance, so you can match your draw and e-liquid easily without handling separate coils. Each pod also includes a drip tip tailored to its vaping style — a narrow tip for MTL precision or a wide-bore tip for airier DTL draws. Choose 1.0ohm or 0.8ohm for mouth-to-lung (MTL) with 50/50 or Nic Salt e-liquids, or the 0.3ohm pod for direct-to-lung (DTL) with high-VG e-liquid. A full-circle adjustable airflow ring lets you refine the draw, while the pod’s leak-resistant structure and secure magnetic base support confident, day-to-day use. These pods work with Voopoo’s PnP X platform devices including the Drag S3 and Drag X3. Note that PnP X integrated-coil pods are not compatible with older, replaceable PnP coils and do not accept separate replaceable coils. Pod Details DTL 0.3ohm PnP-X Pod, We recommend using High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-liquid Only MTL 0.8ohm PnP-X Pod,, We recommend using 50/50 , Nic Salt E-Liquid MTL 1.0ohm PnP-X Pod, We recommend using 50/50 , Nic Salt or High PG E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
